LdapFilter.Not

LdapFilter.Or

LdapFilter.Present
Presence test (attr=*) — the attribute has at least one value (RFC 4515 §2).
LdapFilter.Substring
Substring match (attr=ini*any*fin) (RFC 4515 §2).

A decoded RESP (Redis Serialization Protocol) value.
RespValue.BigNumber
RESP3 big number (3492890328409238509324850943850943825024385\r\n.
RespValue.BulkError
RESP3 bulk error !21\r\nSYNTAX invalid syntax\r\n.
RespValue.BulkString
RESP2 $5\r\nhello\r\n, or the null bulk $-1\r\n when RespValue.BulkString.bytes() is null.
RespValue.RespArray
RESP2 *2\r\n..., or the null array *-1\r\n when RespValue.RespArray.items() is null.
RespValue.RespBoolean
RESP3 boolean #t\r\n / #f\r\n.
RespValue.RespDouble
RESP3 double ,3.14\r\n (also ,inf, ,-inf, ,nan).
RespValue.RespError
RESP2 -ERR message\r\n.
RespValue.RespInteger
RESP2 :123\r\n.
RespValue.RespMap
RESP3 map %2\r\n....
RespValue.RespNull
RESP3 null _\r\n.
RespValue.RespPush
RESP3 push >2\r\n... (out-of-band pub/sub style messages).
RespValue.RespSet
RESP3 set ~2\r\n....
RespValue.SimpleString
RESP2 +OK\r\n.
RespValue.VerbatimString
RESP3 verbatim string =15\r\ntxt:Some string\r\n: a 3-char format tag plus text.
RestClientView

RestRequest.AuthType
 
RestRequest.BodyType

RestRequest.KeyValue

Plans a same-side move — dragging entries into a folder on the very same FileSystem — as a set of FileSystem.rename(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) operations rather than a copy-and-delete.
SameSideMove.Move
One planned rename: item moves from from to to.
SampleCatalog
A bundled, clearly-labelled catalog of public test endpoints so users can connect and try NexusLink immediately.
SavedSessions
An ordered, name-unique list of saved connection profiles ("sessions") for a file-style connector, plus the last local/remote directory each one was left in — the WinSCP/MobaXterm "quick connect to a server and land where I was" behaviour.
SavedSessions.Session
One saved profile.
SchemaAwareDecoder
Turns a Schema-Registry-framed payload into readable text: reads the schema id from the frame, fetches that schema (once, then cached), and decodes the value with it.
SchemaAwareDecoder.Decoded
The decoded text, what kind of payload it was, and the schema id when there was one.
SchemaAwareDecoder.Kind
What a payload turned out to be.
SchemaDiff
Compares two Avro-style record schemas, expressed as JSON, field-by-field so a UI can present a side-by-side version compare.
SchemaDiff.ChangeKind
How a single field differs between the old and new schema.
SchemaDiff.FieldChange
One field's difference.
SchemaExporter
Builds a portable, human-readable structure export of a database — CREATE TABLE DDL for the selected tables (columns with types/nullability/defaults, primary keys, foreign keys and indexes), plus a summary of views.
SchemaProfile
What a sample of documents says the collection's shape is: for every field path, how often it is present, which BSON types it holds and in what proportion, how often it is null, and how many distinct values were seen.
SchemaProfile.FieldProfile
One field path's statistics across the sample.
SchemaRegistryClient
A small client for a Confluent-style Schema Registry REST API (list subjects/versions, fetch a schema by subject+version or by id, and register a new schema version).
SchemaRegistryClient.Schema
A registered schema version.
SchemaRegistryJson
A minimal, dependency-free JSON reader/writer covering exactly what the SchemaRegistryClient needs from Confluent Schema Registry responses: arrays of strings, arrays of integers, and flat objects whose values are strings (one of which — the schema field — is itself an escaped JSON document) or numbers.
SearchResult
One search result from the help index.
SecretField
A field for a secret that is masked by default and can be revealed deliberately.
SecretMaskingFilter
Keeps secret values from leaking into logs and the UI.
SecretsManagerService
A thin AWS Secrets Manager client wrapper: list / create / read / update (new version) / delete secrets, plus a version listing.
SecretsManagerService.SecretSummary
One secret in the list: its name and ARN.
SecretsManagerService.SecretVersion
A stored version of a secret: its version id and the stage labels attached to it (e.g.
SecretVaultsView
External Secret Vaults tab — one sub-tab per backend: HashiCorp Vault (token / AppRole auth + KV v2 CRUD), AWS Secrets Manager (list / get / create / put / delete + versions), and CyberArk Conjur (machine-identity authenticate + read variable).
SecretVaultsView.Kv
A mutable key/value row for the editable KV table.
ServerOutput
How a database hands back the lines a routine printed — Oracle's DBMS_OUTPUT, PostgreSQL's RAISE NOTICE, and everyone else's JDBC warnings — decided from the connection URL alone.
ServiceBusConnectionString
Pure, dependency-free parser for an Azure Service Bus connection string.
ServiceBusConnectionString.MalformedConnectionStringException
Raised when a connection string is empty, malformed, or missing required fields.
ServiceBusService
Azure Service Bus client: manage queues, topics and subscriptions (via the administration API) and send / peek-lock-receive messages against queues and topic subscriptions, including their dead-letter sub-queues.
ServiceBusService.ReceivedMessage
A message received (and settled) from a queue, subscription, or dead-letter sub-queue.
ServiceBusView
Azure Service Bus client tab — connect with a connection string (a real *.servicebus.windows.net namespace or the local emulator via UseDevelopmentEmulator=true) and work with queues (list/create/delete, send, peek-lock receive incl.
SessionMenu
The connect bar's Sessions drop-down: save the filled-in connection form as a named profile, quick-connect to a saved one, or forget it.
Settings
UI-side convenience for reaching the shared SettingsService from any view, mirroring Env and Metrics.
SettingsService
App-facing settings layer over ApplicationConfig.
SftpExplorer
Exposes a connected SftpService as a lazily-loaded directory tree (folders → files).
SftpService
SFTP client over Apache MINA SSHD.
SftpService.SftpEntry
One directory entry.
SftpView
SFTP client tab — connect over SSH (host/port + username/password or a private key) and manage files through a WinSCP/MobaXterm-style two-pane commander: the local disk on the left, the remote server on the right, with upload/download, drag-free transfers, new-folder, rename, delete and chmod.
SftpView.TerminalRequest
A request to open an SSH terminal against this SFTP server, cd'd into dir.
SmiFormatter
Renders SNMP/SMI values as human-readable display strings — the kind of formatting a MIB browser applies when it shows the result of a GET.
SnmpService
SNMP browser client over SNMP4J — community-based v1 / v2c GET and WALK (GETNEXT) over UDP, plus SNMPv3 / USM GET and WALK (SnmpService.getV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String...), SnmpService.walkV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int)).
SnmpService.VarBind
A decoded SNMP variable binding.
SnmpTrapReceiver
Listens on a UDP port (default 162) for incoming SNMP v1 / v2c traps and notifications over SNMP4J, decoding each into an immutable SnmpTrapReceiver.Trap record and delivering it to a registered listener.
SnmpTrapReceiver.Trap
A decoded SNMP trap / notification.
SnmpV3Config
A typed, validated SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM) configuration.
SnmpV3Config.AuthProtocol
USM authentication protocol.
SnmpV3Config.PrivProtocol
USM privacy (encryption) protocol.
SnmpV3Config.SecurityLevel
SNMPv3 message security level.
SnmpV3Usm
Pure mapper from a SnmpV3Config to the SNMP4J User-based Security Model (USM) primitives a v3 session needs: the authentication / privacy protocol OIDs, the SecurityLevel integer, and a localizable UsmUser.
SnmpView
SNMP view with two tabs.
SnmpView.Row
Row model for the results table (JavaFX-bean style for PropertyValueFactory).
SnmpView.TrapRow
Row model for the traps table (one received trap per row).
SnsService
A thin AWS SNS client wrapper: create/list topics, publish, and list subscriptions.
SnsService.Subscription
One topic subscription: its ARN, protocol (sqs/http/…) and endpoint.
SolaceConnectionProfile
Coordinates for a Solace PubSub+ event broker connection over the SMF wire (JCSMP): which Message VPN to enter, which host(s) to reach the broker on, and who to authenticate as.
SolaceJcsmpService
A Solace PubSub+ client over JCSMP (the native SMF API, not JMS).
SolaceJcsmpService.SolaceMessage
One message surfaced to the caller, flattened out of a JCSMP BytesXMLMessage.
SolaceView
Solace PubSub+ client tab — connect to a Message VPN over the SMF wire (JCSMP) and exercise both Solace delivery models: Direct — best-effort pub/sub on topics.
SpanTree
Arranges a flat list of captured ZipkinSpanExporter.Spans into a parent→child forest for a trace-tree view (§9.2).
SpanTree.Node
A node in the trace forest: the span plus its (possibly empty) ordered children.
SqlBindVariables
Finds and resolves the parameters in a statement, following Oracle SQL Developer / SQL*Plus conventions so a query pasted from there behaves the same way here: :name — a bind variable.
SqlBindVariables.Kind
How a parameter's value reaches the database.
SqlBindVariables.Prepared
A statement rewritten for JDBC: positional SQL plus the values to bind, in order.
SqlBindVariables.Variable
One distinct parameter found in a statement.
SqlClientView
JDBC SQL client tab — connect to any JDBC database, run SQL, browse results in a grid, and inspect the schema.
SqlCodeGenerator
Renders a "run this query against this database" snippet — the SQL side of the cross-protocol code-generation SPI.
SqlCodeGenerator.Request
What to generate for.
SqlDialect
The SQL each engine actually accepts, chosen from the JDBC URL.
SqlFormatter
A small, dialect-agnostic SQL pretty-printer for the editor's Format action.
SqlHighlighter
Syntax highlighting for the SQL editor, built on a RichTextFX CodeArea.
SqlInsertBuilder
Pure, dialect-agnostic assembler for a single-row INSERT statement.
SqlQueryBuilder
Pure, dialect-agnostic assembler for a SELECT statement.
SqlQueryBuilder.Condition
A single WHERE predicate: column operator value.
SqlQueryBuilder.Direction
Sort direction for an ORDER BY clause.
SqlQueryBuilder.Operator
A comparison against a single column.
SqlScriptSplitter
Splits a SQL script into individual statements on top-level ; delimiters, correctly ignoring semicolons that appear inside string literals, quoted identifiers, comments and PostgreSQL dollar-quoted bodies.
SqlScriptSplitter.Options
Scanner options.
SqlScriptSplitter.Statement
A statement together with its start offset (first non-whitespace char) in the source script.
SqlToken
A single lexical token carved out of a SQL string by SqlTokenizer.
SqlTokenizer
A pure, dependency-free lexical scanner that splits a SQL string into a contiguous list of SqlTokens tagged with a SqlTokenType.
SqlTokenType
The lexical category of a SqlToken produced by SqlTokenizer.
SqsService
A thin AWS SQS client wrapper: list/create queues, send, receive (long-poll), delete and purge.
SqsService.Message
One received message: its id, body and the receipt handle needed to delete it.
SqsSnsView
AWS SQS + SNS client tab — connect to any SQS/SNS-compatible endpoint (real AWS or LocalStack) and manage queues (list/create/delete, send, long-poll receive, delete, purge, DLQ redrive, FIFO) and topics (list/create/delete, publish, subscriptions).
SseEvent
One Server-Sent Event: its event type (default "message"), optional id, and data.
SseService
A Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) client over the JDK HTTP client.
SseService.Listener
Stream callbacks (invoked off the UI thread).
SseView
Server-Sent Events client tab — connect to a text/event-stream endpoint and watch a live, timestamped event log.
SshTerminalService
An interactive SSH shell session over Apache MINA SSHD — the data plane behind the terminal view.
SslMode
A database-agnostic TLS verification level.
StagePreview
What one aggregation stage produced: its operator, how many documents survive it, a sample of those documents, and how the count moved compared with the stage before it.
StdioMcpTransport
MCP stdio transport: launches an MCP server as a subprocess and exchanges newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages over its stdin/stdout (the canonical local-server transport, e.g.
SyncBrowsing
Pure path math for the commander's "synchronized browsing" mode: when one pane navigates, the other should make the same relative move (descend into the same sub-folders, or climb the same number of levels).
SyncPlanner
Turns a DirectoryDiff into an ordered list of concrete SyncPlanner.Actions to reconcile two panes — the planning core of SyncService (7.1).
SyncPlanner.Action
One planned operation.
SyncPlanner.Mode
The reconciliation strategy chosen by the user.
SyncPlanner.Op
The primitive a planned SyncPlanner.Action performs.
TableContextMenus
One-call, desktop-style right-click interactivity for any TableView: Copy (the focused cell), Copy row(s) (tab-separated, spreadsheet-friendly), and Copy all as CSV.
TableCopy
Pure formatters for copying tabular data to the clipboard — tab-separated (for pasting into a spreadsheet cell-by-cell) and RFC 4180 CSV.
TerminalView
An interactive SSH terminal tab: a connect bar (host/port/user + password or private-key auth, and an optional local port forward) over a Canvas that renders a VtScreen in a monospace font with xterm-256 colours.
ThemeManager
Central theme controller.
ThemeManager.Theme
Available themes; ThemeManager.Theme.cssPath() points at the palette stylesheet.
TlsConfig
TLS / mTLS material for a connection: an optional trust store (the CA certificates used to verify the server) and an optional key store (the client certificate + key presented for mutual TLS).
TlsContextFactory
Builds an SSLContext from a TlsConfig: a key manager from the client key store (for mutual TLS), and a trust manager from the trust store (the CAs to trust) — or a trust-all manager, or the JDK default.
TooltipPlus
"Tooltip-plus": attaches a richer hover tooltip to a field and wires F1 (while the field is focused) to open contextual help.
TraceContext
Pure, dependency-free model of the W3C Trace Context (Level 1) distributed-tracing headers, traceparent and tracestate.
TraceContext.TraceState
A parsed, ordered tracestate list of at most 32 key=value members.
TraceContext.TraceState.Member
One key=value tracestate member.
TraceTreeView
Distributed-trace tree view (§9.2): renders the spans captured during a REST session as an expandable parent→child tree, grouped by trace, each node showing its name, duration and HTTP status.
TransferErrors
Classifies a transfer failure as transient (worth an automatic retry — a dropped connection, a timeout, a temporarily unreachable host) or permanent (bad credentials, missing file, no permission — retrying won't help).
TransferGovernor
Pause/resume + bandwidth-throttle control for the TransferQueue, applied at the one place every FileTransfer implementation already reports through: the cumulative-bytes progress callback (called per 64 KB chunk).
TransferGovernor.Sleeper
Sleeps for the given number of milliseconds; injectable so tests can record instead of wait.
TransferIntegrity
Verifies a completed transfer by comparing the source against what actually landed on the destination: the byte count must match, and — when the caller can supply a checksum for both sides — the digests must match too.
TransferIntegrity.Issue
A specific way a transfer failed verification.
TransferIntegrity.Report
The verdict for one file.
TransferItem
One queued file transfer in a TransferQueue.
TransferItem.Direction
Transfer direction relative to the two-pane browser (local ⇄ remote).
TransferQueue
Drives the existing FileTransfer copy logic for a batch of TransferItems, exposing observable per-item and overall progress.
TransferQueue.Listener
Receives queue change notifications (off any thread — UI listeners must marshal to FX).
TransferQueuePanel
A collapsible panel showing the live TransferQueue: a table with per-row progress bars, an overall progress bar, status counts and a "Clear completed" button.
TransferStatus
Lifecycle of a single TransferItem as it moves through the TransferQueue.
UriRedactor
Hides the credentials inside a connection string, and shortens it to something that fits on one line, for the places a connection is displayed rather than edited.
UriTemplate
Pure, dependency-free expander for URI Templates as defined by RFC 6570 (Levels 1–3).
UriTemplate.UriTemplateException
Thrown when a URI Template is syntactically malformed (unbalanced braces, unknown operator, etc.).
UserDriver
A JDBC driver the user added themselves by pointing at a jar on disk — the escape hatch for databases NexusLink doesn't know about, and for organisations whose approved driver build is only available from an internal share.
UserDriverStore
Persists the drivers a user added from their own filesystem, in ~/.nexuslink/user-drivers.json.
UserDriverStore.Data
On-disk shape — a wrapper object so the format can gain fields without breaking readers.
UsmPrivacy
The privacy (encryption) half of the SNMPv3 User-based Security Model, complementing the auth-only UsmSecurity.
UsmPrivacy.Encrypted
The output of an encryption: the ciphertext plus the privParameters (the salt) that the peer needs — alongside the shared localized key and, for AES, the engine boots/time — to reconstruct the IV and decrypt.
UsmPrivacy.PrivProtocol
USM privacy protocol selector.
UsmSecurity
The cryptographic core of the SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM, RFC 3414).
UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol
USM authentication protocol — selects both the digest and the HMAC variant.
ValidationResult
 
ValidationResult.ValidationError
 
VariableInterpolator
Substitutes ${VAR} placeholders in any string field using a pluggable resolver (normally EnvironmentService).
VaultBackupException
Signals that an encrypted vault backup could not be exported, imported, or restored.
VaultBackupService
Produces and restores portable, passphrase-encrypted backups of a CredentialVault.
VaultPaths
Pure, dependency-free helpers for building HashiCorp Vault KV v2 API paths and normalising a server address.
VaultService
A thin HashiCorp Vault client over the JDK HTTP client (no heavy HTTP dependency).
VaultService.KvSecret
A KV v2 secret: its current version number and the string key/value pairs it holds.
VaultService.VaultException
Unchecked wrapper for any Vault transport/API error, so callers catch one type.
VaultSession
App-wide gateway to the CredentialVault.
VaultStore
Persists a CredentialVault to (and from) a JSON file on disk.
VtScreen
A pure, dependency-free VT100/xterm screen-buffer model — the offline-testable core of the SSH terminal.
VtScreen.Cell
One character cell: the glyph plus its 256-colour foreground/background and bold flag.
WebSocketService
WebSocket client over the JDK's WebSocket (RFC 6455, zero deps).
WebSocketService.Listener
Events surfaced to the UI.
WebSocketView
WebSocket client tab — connect to a ws:// or wss:// endpoint, send text frames, and watch a live, timestamped message log with direction markers.
ZipkinSpanExporter
Renders captured request spans into the Zipkin v2 JSON format — the wire format also accepted by Jaeger's Zipkin-compatible collector.
ZipkinSpanExporter.Kind
Span kind on the wire; ZipkinSpanExporter.Kind.NONE omits the kind field.
ZipkinSpanExporter.Span
One span.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
